title: Accepted-state automatic surface-water management policy
purpose: Qualify the legacy SWMAN=2 target-selection and WLSTAR memory semantics as an explicit coupler policy, independent of Ribasim hydraulic realization.

frozen_policy.units: legacy-compatible centimetres and days for this policy test
algorithm: while phase>1 and GWL > GWLCRIT(phase): decrement
while phase>1 and VTAIR < VCRIT(phase): decrement
while phase>1 and HSEL > HCRIT(phase): decrement
if requested < accepted WLSTAR and DROPR>0.001, candidate target=max(requested, accepted WLSTAR-DROPR*dt)
between explicit adjustment events requested target is accepted WLSTAR exactly

transaction_cases: Evaluate a downward candidate from accepted WLSTAR=-20 with dt=2 d; discard it and prove accepted state remains -20.
Replay from the same accepted origin and forcing and require bitwise-identical candidate fields.
Commit once and require accepted WLSTAR equals candidate target.
Evaluate a retry from the original accepted origin with dt=1 d and require target=-25, proving dt-sensitive candidate computation does not leak across rejected trials.

seam_case.rationale: legacy condition is DROPR>0.001; equality disables limiting

pass_criteria: All frozen phase selections exactly match expected phase.
All requested and rate-limited candidate targets match to 1e-12 cm.
No evaluation mutates accepted policy state.
Rejected candidate leaves accepted WLSTAR unchanged.
DROPR equality seam and upward-change asymmetry are preserved.
nonclaims: No claim that the legacy automatic hydraulic capacity branch should be copied.
No Ribasim level-band realization yet; that is Q2B.
